summary: Micware Co., Ltd., a Japan-based software services provider, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 3, 2026 press release and investor presentation announcing a new growth strategy centered on two platform businesses, micAuto (mobility) and DynaPlanet (spatial digital). The filing describes strategic direction, new logos, and planned KPIs for these platforms. No financial terms, transaction structure, or board action are involved. This is a routine corporate-strategy disclosure with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring. The filing merely communicates forward-looking business plans and contains no offer or solicitation. What to watch would be future operational updates on these platforms, but no event-driven angle applies today.
